why_pending: Every trial case needs the operator's own work over at least five distinct workdays and the operator's explicit confirmation. Neither can be produced by a test run. What exists is the candidate build, the operator's guide (docs/daily-driver-trial.md), an empty log (session-20/trial-log.md), and a rehearsal of the transition and rollback instructions with stand-in agents in a disposable world on the MacBook Pro. The rehearsal is recorded under `rehearsal` and is deliberately not counted as any case.

multiple-profiles.required: agents under at least two profiles at once in real work, with no crossover

all-harnesses.required: Claude, Codex, and Copilot each launched, used, and resumed in the workspace

permission-prompts.required: permission and question prompts raised, seen, answered from the embedded terminal, and cleared

long-running-jobs.required: agents left working for hours across app close/reopen and sleep, found again intact

asl.required: a real asl run supervised from the workspace, including a mailbox question and its reply

overview.required: the overview used in real work to watch and focus several agents

conversation-continuity.required: continue, fork, and handoff from Past Sessions; a conversation resumed after its agent ended

affected-acceptance-rerun.required: each trial defect fixed and its affected acceptance checks rerun, or an explicit statement that the trial found none

rollback.required: the rollback carried out on the operator's installation, or the rehearsal accepted by the operator with the reason recorded

kitty-fallback.required: a deliberate Kitty launch during the trial with tmux as the default, and pre-transition Kitty sessions finished in place

rehearsal.what: The transition and rollback steps 1 to 3 of docs/daily-driver-trial.md, on the candidate build, in the Session 19 world on Seb's MacBook Pro (macOS 27.0.1, arm64): app installed by install-app.sh into a disposable root, an amx outside the app, a real Kitty 0.48.2 of the run's own, stand-in agents that send real hooks.
rehearsal.observed: 43 passed, 0 failed (second pass; the first pass's 9 failures were driver mistakes, see session-20/driver/README.md). A Kitty session launched before the switch stayed the same process in the same tab, kept reporting to the daemon, and ended in place. With launch_backend = "tmux" a launch with no --backend went to the private server and the app attached one xterm-ghostty terminal to it; --backend kitty still opened a Kitty tab. After the switch was reverted a launch opened a Kitty tab while the tmux agent stayed the same process on the same server. uninstall-app.sh removed the app and left that agent running, answering its terminal, and live to `amx attach --json`; a --backend tmux launch still worked with the app gone. `amx backend stop --yes` ended the server and both agents and left the Kitty session and its hooks untouched; config.toml ended as it began. Teardown: no process left, the MacBook user's own amx, AgentMux directories, Kitty configuration, and app preferences unchanged.
rehearsal.not_shown: Rollback step 4 (reinstalling the earlier build, amx revision 5645f028f120) was not rehearsed. Nothing was installed into /Applications. No real harness ran. No Developer ID signature or notarization exists. A launch from the app's own menu was not driven.
